name: Essence Channeler
description: As long as you've lost life this turn, this creature has flying and vigilance. Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. When this creature dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
assumptions: Read node C's static flying+vigilance grant as unconditional (no cond: payload signals a gate).
couldNotDerive: The condition gating node C ("as long as you've lost life this turn") -- not represented in the data at all, so the examiner correctly, but wrongly, read it as an always-on static.
The exact meaning of node G's delta=EachFromSource (correctly inferred as "for each +1/+1 counter on this creature" from context, but the raw value itself doesn't say so).
notes: Two real, unfixed gaps: (1) Mode$Continuous | CheckSVar$X | SVar:X:PlayerCountPropertyYou$LifeLostThisTurn is a conditional static ("as long as you've lost life this turn, has flying and vigilance") -- the translator has zero support for CheckSVar$ gates on statics at all, so it unconditionally grants the keywords, same underlying unsupported-dynamic-condition class as ConditionCheckSVar$/ConditionSVarCompare$ (see known_gap_classes) just on a different field name (CheckSVar$ rather than ConditionCheckSVar$/ConditionSVarCompare$) -- added to that gap class's description as a related field to watch for. (2) CounterType$EachFromSource (a dynamic "however many counters were on the dying source" amount) passes through PutCounter's type-naming logic as the raw literal string "EachFromSource" instead of a readable value -- the examiner still inferred the correct meaning from context, but the encoding itself is opaque. Neither fixed this round -- (1) needs the same design decision as the broader Condition class, (2) is a narrower cosmetic improvement.
